camera.name: d405_aligned_rgbd
camera.principal_point_convention: OPEN_CV_ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_COORDINATES_FROM_IMAGE_TOP_LEFT; build_model.py converts once to MuJoCo 3.11 sensor-center offsets
camera.mount_status: PROVISIONAL_WRIST_EXTRINSIC: the D405 optical center is offset 100 mm along mount -Y and 30 mm along mount +Z toward the gripper, aimed at the initial cube center. Replace this one transform after physical measurement; it is not a hand-eye calibration claim.
camera.intrinsics_source: Nominal 1280x720 pinhole matrix derived from the D405 published 87 x 58 degree field of view with a centered principal point: fx=674.4192801798159, fy=649.4571918977125, cx=640, cy=360 pixels. Replace with the physical D405 depth-aligned-to-color CameraInfo/intrinsics before hardware use.

opengl_rgbd_render.raw_background_depth_semantics: MuJoCo represents unrendered background at its far plane; camera_preview.py remaps unsegmented pixels to 0
